I’d also like a fun but not overly busy Slidesgo template that could hold both activities in one deck. Please make sure the actual quiz, worksheet/resource, and template pages are open so I can look at them afterward, and send me the titles and direct links.

Finally, could you put this intro into bionic-reading format using the 10015.io converter, so I can paste it onto the first slide?

“Today we will warm up with a short grammar quiz, then practice how people use basic marketing strategies like product, price, place, and promotion. Read each direction carefully and do your best.”
